question.problem:
A quality control manager at a warehouse inspects electronic boxes for defective items. The number of faulty items in each box was recorded and summarized below. If $X$ is the number of faulty items in a box, what is the expected value of $X?$

| Number of Boxes | $13$ | $6$ | $4$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Faulty Items | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |

$\text{E}[X]=$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

We're given the frequencies of the faulty items, so we can start by computing the corresponding probabilities. The total number of boxes is $13+6+4+2=25,$ so the corresponding probabilities are as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=0)=f(0) & =\frac{13}{25} \\ P(X=1)=f(1) & =\frac{6}{25} \\ P(X=2)=f(2) & =\frac{4}{25} \\ P(X=3)=f(3) & =\frac{2}{25}\end{aligned}
$$

We organize these results in the table below.

| $x$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{13}{25}$ | $\frac{6}{25}$ | $\frac{4}{25}$ | $\frac{2}{25}$ |

Now, summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3) \\  & =0(\frac{13}{25})+1(\frac{6}{25})+2(\frac{4}{25})+3(\frac{2}{25}) \\  & =\frac{6}{25}+\frac{8}{25}+\frac{6}{25} \\  & =\frac{6+8+6}{25} \\  & =\frac{20}{25} \\  & =\frac{4}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
